messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — Acme POC is seeing 0 usage in the Console for their free credits but the invoice preview shows charges. They're pretty concerned. Anyone available to triage?

Rob (Eng): Looking now. @Maya can you paste the org id and one sample request id/timestamp? Could be a test/demo meter vs their trial org.

Maya (AE): Org id: org_98765. Sample request id from their logs: req_2026-03-19-abc123. Screenshot url: https://img.internal/acme-poc (they sent privately).

Jay (Support): I can see traffic around that req id on our ingress. There are some rate-limit spikes in the same window, which caused some retries. Those retries might show as extra tokens on billing. :thinking_face:

Rob (Eng): Quick question — did they use the dashboard-generated org key or the docs "Try sample app" demo key? Demo/test keys route to the shared demo meter and won't attribute to their org. Also note: promo/free credits allocation is applied during post-processing, so the Console might show 0 until reconciliation (usually within 24h).

Emily (Finance): To add: promo credits (marketing/grant style) are applied asynchronously. If this was a manual credit we issued, it may not appear immediately in the invoice preview. We should confirm whether this is a "promo" or "trial" credit.

Maya (AE): They say they copied the key from the invite email and added it to their app. They pasted the request header they captured:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-test-01
x-org-id: org_98765
```
But they insist it was the key from the invite.

Rob (Eng): That Authorization value looks like a short test key (sk-test-01). Test/demo keys are intentionally short and map to the demo meter. If their requests used that key, usage will be attributed to demo, not org_98765's billing account. The x-org-id alone doesn't re-attribute if the key is demo-scoped.

Jay (Support): Confirmed in the logs: requests with req_2026-03-19-abc123 are tagged demo-meter in our ingest. So Console for org_98765 shows 0, but the platform-level invoice preview aggregates demo-meter usage elsewhere.

Rob (Eng): Proposed remediation steps:
1) Collect request ids/time range (we have req_2026-03-19-abc123 and two others).
2) Run attribution job for those request ids to re-map to billing_account org_98765 (ops/billing).
3) If they used a test key, either re-run attribution or issue a credit equal to the charged tokens and advise them to create an org-scoped key.

Maya (AE): I passed the ask to Acme to confirm which key they used and asked for additional request ids. They replied with two more ids: req_2026-03-19-def456, req_2026-03-19-ghi789.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BLG-4321 — "POC invoice reconciliation for org_98765 (reqs: abc123, def456, ghi789)"

Emily (Finance): If we credit, we need the token counts. Rob, can you extract token counts for those request ids so we can calculate the amount?

Rob (Eng): Pulled token totals: abc123=6,204 tokens, def456=5,112 tokens, ghi789=7,116 tokens. Combined = 18,432 tokens. At current hosted rate that's approx $0.18. Small amount — recommend issuing a credit and fixing attribution so Console reflects 0 going forward.

Maya (AE): Customer is okay with a credit. They mainly want to know how to avoid this. Can we give a short how-to? :pray:

Rob (Eng): Short how-to for them to avoid: 1) In Console -> Team -> API Keys: Create a key labeled "POC - Acme" (this gives an sk-org... key). 2) Replace any demo/test keys — do NOT use "Try sample app" demo key. 3) Include the x-org-id header (x-org-id: org_98765) and the org-scoped Bearer key in all requests. 4) If you hit unexpected charged tokens, collect request ids and ping us immediately.

Maya (AE): I'll send those steps + confirmation about the credit. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Jay (Support): I'll follow up with ops to run the attribution job and update BLG-4321 when done.

Rob (Eng): Also adding a short docs snippet for the 'POC checklist' that we can share in future handoffs (create org key, avoid demo button, sample header snippet).

Maya (AE): Perfect — closing loop with Acme now.
